vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: equity-valuation-framework
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle is benign. The `SKILL.md` file provides detailed instructions for an AI agent to perform equity valuation, including data quality checks, valuation methodologies, scenario analysis, and a strict report output template. Crucially, it explicitly states that the skill 'does not fetch data' and instructs the agent to 'avoid absolute buy/sell commands'. There are no indications of prompt injection attempts, data exfiltration, unauthorized access, or any other malicious or suspicious activities across any of the files. All instructions are focused on structured analytical processing of provided data.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only valuation playbook that only transforms provided financial inputs into a structured report and does not request credentials, install software, or perform data fetching—its declared scope and requirements are internally consistent.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the SKILL.md: it is a valuation playbook and report template. The skill requires no binaries, env vars, or installs and explicitly states it does not fetch data. All requested inputs (financials, price history, peers, macro/news) are appropriate and proportional for the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to validating input quality, running valuation modules (multiples, DCF, sector adaptations), producing scenario analyses, and formatting a report. The SKILL.md does not instruct the agent to read unrelated files, access hidden config paths, or transmit data to external endpoints. It relies on upstream data providers but does not itself perform fetching or exfiltration.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files — this is instruction-only. Nothing is written to disk or downloaded as part of the skill, which minimizes installation risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The input contract expects financial data to be supplied by upstream skills; this is appropriate. Users should, however, verify the upstream data sources that will supply those inputs for their own credential/network behavior.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled (always: false) and follows normal autonomous invocation defaults. It does not request persistent system privileges or attempt to modify other skills' configurations.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and safe as an instruction-only valuation playbook. Before installing or enabling it for autonomous use, confirm which upstream data-provider skills (e.g., vnstock-free-expert, nso-macro-monitor) you'll pair it with and review those skills for network access, required API keys, or data-exfiltration risks. Also ensure the agent is supplied with complete, high-quality inputs (the skill relies on that) and consider whether you want the agent to run autonomously when producing decision-grade outputs.
